    24	DEFAULT_MODE = RTLD_LOCAL
    25	if _os.name == "posix" and _sys.platform == "darwin":
    26	    # On OS X 10.3, we use RTLD_GLOBAL as default mode
    27	    # because RTLD_LOCAL does not work at least on some
    28	    # libraries.  OS X 10.3 is Darwin 7, so we check for
    29	    # that.
    30	
    31	    if int(_os.uname().release.split('.')[0]) < 8:
    32	        DEFAULT_MODE = RTLD_GLOBAL

    49	def create_string_buffer(init, size=None):
    50	    """create_string_buffer(aBytes) -> character array
    51	    create_string_buffer(anInteger) -> character array
    52	    create_string_buffer(aBytes, anInteger) -> character array
    53	    """
    54	    if isinstance(init, bytes):
    55	        if size is None:
    56	            size = len(init)+1
    57	        _sys.audit("ctypes.create_string_buffer", init, size)
    58	        buftype = c_char * size
    59	        buf = buftype()
    60	        buf.value = init
    61	        return buf
    62	    elif isinstance(init, int):
    63	        _sys.audit("ctypes.create_string_buffer", None, init)
    64	        buftype = c_char * init
    65	        buf = buftype()
    66	        return buf
    67	    raise TypeError(init)
    68	
    69	# Alias to create_string_buffer() for backward compatibility
    70	c_buffer = create_string_buffer
    71	
    72	_c_functype_cache = {}
    73	def CFUNCTYPE(restype, *argtypes, **kw):
    74	    """CFUNCTYPE(restype, *argtypes,
    75	                 use_errno=False, use_last_error=False) -> function prototype.
    76	
    77	    restype: the result type
    78	    argtypes: a sequence specifying the argument types
    79	
    80	    The function prototype can be called in different ways to create a
    81	    callable object:
    82	
    83	    prototype(integer address) -> foreign function
    84	    prototype(callable) -> create and return a C callable function from callable
    85	    prototype(integer index, method name[, paramflags]) -> foreign function calling a COM method
    86	    prototype((ordinal number, dll object)[, paramflags]) -> foreign function exported by ordinal
    87	    prototype((function name, dll object)[, paramflags]) -> foreign function exported by name
    88	    """
    89	    flags = _FUNCFLAG_CDECL
    90	    if kw.pop("use_errno", False):
    91	        flags |= _FUNCFLAG_USE_ERRNO
    92	    if kw.pop("use_last_error", False):
    93	        flags |= _FUNCFLAG_USE_LASTERROR
    94	    if kw:
    95	        raise ValueError("unexpected keyword argument(s) %s" % kw.keys())
    96	
    97	    try:
    98	        return _c_functype_cache[(restype, argtypes, flags)]
    99	    except KeyError:
   100	        pass
   101	
   102	    class CFunctionType(_CFuncPtr):
   103	        _argtypes_ = argtypes
   104	        _restype_ = restype
   105	        _flags_ = flags
   106	    _c_functype_cache[(restype, argtypes, flags)] = CFunctionType
   107	    return CFunctionType
   108	
   109	if _os.name == "nt":
   110	    from _ctypes import LoadLibrary as _dlopen
   111	    from _ctypes import FUNCFLAG_STDCALL as _FUNCFLAG_STDCALL
   112	
   113	    _win_functype_cache = {}
   114	    def WINFUNCTYPE(restype, *argtypes, **kw):
   115	        # docstring set later (very similar to CFUNCTYPE.__doc__)
   116	        flags = _FUNCFLAG_STDCALL
   117	        if kw.pop("use_errno", False):
   118	            flags |= _FUNCFLAG_USE_ERRNO
   119	        if kw.pop("use_last_error", False):
   120	            flags |= _FUNCFLAG_USE_LASTERROR
   121	        if kw:
   122	            raise ValueError("unexpected keyword argument(s) %s" % kw.keys())
   123	
   124	        try:
   125	            return _win_functype_cache[(restype, argtypes, flags)]
   126	        except KeyError:
   127	            pass
   128	
   129	        class WinFunctionType(_CFuncPtr):
   130	            _argtypes_ = argtypes
   131	            _restype_ = restype
   132	            _flags_ = flags
   133	        _win_functype_cache[(restype, argtypes, flags)] = WinFunctionType
   134	        return WinFunctionType
   135	    if WINFUNCTYPE.__doc__:
   136	        WINFUNCTYPE.__doc__ = CFUNCTYPE.__doc__.replace("CFUNCTYPE", "WINFUNCTYPE")
   137

   145	def _check_size(typ, typecode=None):
   146	    # Check if sizeof(ctypes_type) against struct.calcsize.  This
   147	    # should protect somewhat against a misconfigured libffi.
   148	    from struct import calcsize
   149	    if typecode is None:
   150	        # Most _type_ codes are the same as used in struct
   151	        typecode = typ._type_
   152	    actual, required = sizeof(typ), calcsize(typecode)
   153	    if actual != required:
   154	        raise SystemError("sizeof(%s) wrong: %d instead of %d" % \
   155	                          (typ, actual, required))
   156	
   157	class py_object(_SimpleCData):
   158	    _type_ = "O"
   159	    def __repr__(self):
   160	        try:
   161	            return super().__repr__()
   162	        except ValueError:
   163	            return "%s(<NULL>)" % type(self).__name__
   164	_check_size(py_object, "P")
   165	
   166	class c_short(_SimpleCData):
   167	    _type_ = "h"
   168	_check_size(c_short)
   169	
   170	class c_ushort(_SimpleCData):
   171	    _type_ = "H"
   172	_check_size(c_ushort)

   174	class c_long(_SimpleCData):
   175	    _type_ = "l"
   176	_check_size(c_long)
   177	
   178	class c_ulong(_SimpleCData):
   179	    _type_ = "L"
   180	_check_size(c_ulong)

   182	if _calcsize("i") == _calcsize("l"):
   183	    # if int and long have the same size, make c_int an alias for c_long
   184	    c_int = c_long
   185	    c_uint = c_ulong
   186	else:
   187	    class c_int(_SimpleCData):
   188	        _type_ = "i"
   189	    _check_size(c_int)
   190	
   191	    class c_uint(_SimpleCData):
   192	        _type_ = "I"
   193	    _check_size(c_uint)

   196	    _type_ = "f"

   200	    _type_ = "d"
   201	_check_size(c_double)
   202	
   203	class c_longdouble(_SimpleCData):
   204	    _type_ = "g"
   205	if sizeof(c_longdouble) == sizeof(c_double):
   206	    c_longdouble = c_double
   207	
   208	if _calcsize("l") == _calcsize("q"):
   209	    # if long and long long have the same size, make c_longlong an alias for c_long
   210	    c_longlong = c_long
   211	    c_ulonglong = c_ulong
   212	else:
   213	    class c_longlong(_SimpleCData):
   214	        _type_ = "q"
   215	    _check_size(c_longlong)
   216	
   217	    class c_ulonglong(_SimpleCData):
   218	        _type_ = "Q"
   219	    ##    def from_param(cls, val):
   220	    ##        return ('d', float(val), val)
   221	    ##    from_param = classmethod(from_param)
   222	    _check_size(c_ulonglong)

   265	def _reset_cache():
   266	    _pointer_type_cache.clear()
   267	    _c_functype_cache.clear()
   268	    if _os.name == "nt":
   269	        _win_functype_cache.clear()
   270	    # _SimpleCData.c_wchar_p_from_param
   271	    POINTER(c_wchar).from_param = c_wchar_p.from_param
   272	    # _SimpleCData.c_char_p_from_param
   273	    POINTER(c_char).from_param = c_char_p.from_param
   274	    _pointer_type_cache[None] = c_void_p

   276	def create_unicode_buffer(init, size=None):
   277	    """create_unicode_buffer(aString) -> character array
   278	    create_unicode_buffer(anInteger) -> character array
   279	    create_unicode_buffer(aString, anInteger) -> character array
   280	    """
   281	    if isinstance(init, str):
   282	        if size is None:
   283	            if sizeof(c_wchar) == 2:
   284	                # UTF-16 requires a surrogate pair (2 wchar_t) for non-BMP
   285	                # characters (outside [U+0000; U+FFFF] range). +1 for trailing
   286	                # NUL character.
   287	                size = sum(2 if ord(c) > 0xFFFF else 1 for c in init) + 1
   288	            else:
   289	                # 32-bit wchar_t (1 wchar_t per Unicode character). +1 for
   290	                # trailing NUL character.
   291	                size = len(init) + 1
   292	        _sys.audit("ctypes.create_unicode_buffer", init, size)
   293	        buftype = c_wchar * size
   294	        buf = buftype()
   295	        buf.value = init
   296	        return buf
   297	    elif isinstance(init, int):
   298	        _sys.audit("ctypes.create_unicode_buffer", None, init)
   299	        buftype = c_wchar * init
   300	        buf = buftype()
   301	        return buf
   302	    raise TypeError(init)
   303

   305	# XXX Deprecated
   306	def SetPointerType(pointer, cls):
   307	    if _pointer_type_cache.get(cls, None) is not None:
   308	        raise RuntimeError("This type already exists in the cache")
   309	    if id(pointer) not in _pointer_type_cache:
   310	        raise RuntimeError("What's this???")
   311	    pointer.set_type(cls)
   312	    _pointer_type_cache[cls] = pointer
   313	    del _pointer_type_cache[id(pointer)]
   314	
   315	# XXX Deprecated
   316	def ARRAY(typ, len):
   317	    return typ * len

   322	class CDLL(object):
   323	    """An instance of this class represents a loaded dll/shared
   324	    library, exporting functions using the standard C calling
   325	    convention (named 'cdecl' on Windows).
   326	
   327	    The exported functions can be accessed as attributes, or by
   328	    indexing with the function name.  Examples:
   329	
   330	    <obj>.qsort -> callable object
   331	    <obj>['qsort'] -> callable object
   332	
   333	    Calling the functions releases the Python GIL during the call and
   334	    reacquires it afterwards.
   335	    """
   336	    _func_flags_ = _FUNCFLAG_CDECL
   337	    _func_restype_ = c_int
   338	    # default values for repr
   339	    _name = '<uninitialized>'
   340	    _handle = 0
   341	    _FuncPtr = None
   342	
   343	    def __init__(self, name, mode=DEFAULT_MODE, handle=None,
   344	                 use_errno=False,
   345	                 use_last_error=False,
   346	                 winmode=None):
   347	        if name:
   348	            name = _os.fspath(name)
   349	        self._name = name
   350	        flags = self._func_flags_
   351	        if use_errno:
   352	            flags |= _FUNCFLAG_USE_ERRNO
   353	        if use_last_error:
   354	            flags |= _FUNCFLAG_USE_LASTERROR
   355	        if _sys.platform.startswith("aix"):
   356	            """When the name contains ".a(" and ends with ")",
   357	               e.g., "libFOO.a(libFOO.so)" - this is taken to be an
   358	               archive(member) syntax for dlopen(), and the mode is adjusted.
   359	               Otherwise, name is presented to dlopen() as a file argument.
   360	            """
   361	            if name and name.endswith(")") and ".a(" in name:
   362	                mode |= ( _os.RTLD_MEMBER | _os.RTLD_NOW )
   363	        if _os.name == "nt":
   364	            if winmode is not None:
   365	                mode = winmode
   366	            else:
   367	                import nt
   368	                mode = nt._LOAD_LIBRARY_SEARCH_DEFAULT_DIRS
   369	                if '/' in name or '\\' in name:
   370	                    self._name = nt._getfullpathname(self._name)
   371	                    mode |= nt._LOAD_LIBRARY_SEARCH_DLL_LOAD_DIR
   372	
   373	        class _FuncPtr(_CFuncPtr):
   374	            _flags_ = flags
   375	            _restype_ = self._func_restype_
   376	        self._FuncPtr = _FuncPtr
   377	
   378	        if handle is None:
   379	            self._handle = _dlopen(self._name, mode)
   380	        else:
   381	            self._handle = handle
   382	
   383	    def __repr__(self):
   384	        return "<%s '%s', handle %x at %#x>" % \
   385	               (self.__class__.__name__, self._name,
   386	                (self._handle & (_sys.maxsize*2 + 1)),
   387	                id(self) & (_sys.maxsize*2 + 1))
   388	
   389	    def __getattr__(self, name):
   390	        if name.startswith('__') and name.endswith('__'):
   391	            raise AttributeError(name)
   392	        func = self.__getitem__(name)
   393	        setattr(self, name, func)
   394	        return func
   395	
   396	    def __getitem__(self, name_or_ordinal):
   397	        func = self._FuncPtr((name_or_ordinal, self))
   398	        if not isinstance(name_or_ordinal, int):
   399	            func.__name__ = name_or_ordinal
   400	        return func
   401	
   402	class PyDLL(CDLL):
   403	    """This class represents the Python library itself.  It allows
   404	    accessing Python API functions.  The GIL is not released, and
   405	    Python exceptions are handled correctly.
   406	    """
   407	    _func_flags_ = _FUNCFLAG_CDECL | _FUNCFLAG_PYTHONAPI
   408	
   409	if _os.name == "nt":
   410	
   411	    class WinDLL(CDLL):
   412	        """This class represents a dll exporting functions using the
   413	        Windows stdcall calling convention.
   414	        """
   415	        _func_flags_ = _FUNCFLAG_STDCALL
   416	
   417	    # XXX Hm, what about HRESULT as normal parameter?
   418	    # Mustn't it derive from c_long then?
   419	    from _ctypes import _check_HRESULT, _SimpleCData
   420	    class HRESULT(_SimpleCData):
   421	        _type_ = "l"
   422	        # _check_retval_ is called with the function's result when it
   423	        # is used as restype.  It checks for the FAILED bit, and
   424	        # raises an OSError if it is set.
   425	        #
   426	        # The _check_retval_ method is implemented in C, so that the
   427	        # method definition itself is not included in the traceback
   428	        # when it raises an error - that is what we want (and Python
   429	        # doesn't have a way to raise an exception in the caller's
   430	        # frame).
   431	        _check_retval_ = _check_HRESULT
   432	
   433	    class OleDLL(CDLL):
   434	        """This class represents a dll exporting functions using the
   435	        Windows stdcall calling convention, and returning HRESULT.
   436	        HRESULT error values are automatically raised as OSError
   437	        exceptions.
   438	        """
   439	        _func_flags_ = _FUNCFLAG_STDCALL
   440	        _func_restype_ = HRESULT
   441	
   442	class LibraryLoader(object):
   443	    def __init__(self, dlltype):
   444	        self._dlltype = dlltype
   445	
   446	    def __getattr__(self, name):
   447	        if name[0] == '_':
   448	            raise AttributeError(name)
   449	        try:
   450	            dll = self._dlltype(name)
   451	        except OSError:
   452	            raise AttributeError(name)
   453	        setattr(self, name, dll)
   454	        return dll
   455	
   456	    def __getitem__(self, name):
   457	        return getattr(self, name)
   458	
   459	    def LoadLibrary(self, name):
   460	        return self._dlltype(name)
   461	
   462	    __class_getitem__ = classmethod(_types.GenericAlias)
   463	
   464	cdll = LibraryLoader(CDLL)
   465	pydll = LibraryLoader(PyDLL)
   466	
   467	if _os.name == "nt":
   468	    pythonapi = PyDLL("python dll", None, _sys.dllhandle)
   469	elif _sys.platform == "cygwin":
   470	    pythonapi = PyDLL("libpython%d.%d.dll" % _sys.version_info[:2])
   471	else:
   472	    pythonapi = PyDLL(None)
   473	
   474	
   475	if _os.name == "nt":
   476	    windll = LibraryLoader(WinDLL)
   477	    oledll = LibraryLoader(OleDLL)
   478	
   479	    GetLastError = windll.kernel32.GetLastError
   480	    from _ctypes import get_last_error, set_last_error
   481	
   482	    def WinError(code=None, descr=None):
   483	        if code is None:
   484	            code = GetLastError()
   485	        if descr is None:
   486	            descr = FormatError(code).strip()
   487	        return OSError(None, descr, None, code)

   489	if sizeof(c_uint) == sizeof(c_void_p):
   490	    c_size_t = c_uint
   491	    c_ssize_t = c_int
   492	elif sizeof(c_ulong) == sizeof(c_void_p):
   493	    c_size_t = c_ulong
   494	    c_ssize_t = c_long
   495	elif sizeof(c_ulonglong) == sizeof(c_void_p):
   496	    c_size_t = c_ulonglong
   497	    c_ssize_t = c_longlong

   503	## void *memmove(void *, const void *, size_t);
   504	memmove = CFUNCTYPE(c_void_p, c_void_p, c_void_p, c_size_t)(_memmove_addr)

   509	def PYFUNCTYPE(restype, *argtypes):
   510	    class CFunctionType(_CFuncPtr):
   511	        _argtypes_ = argtypes
   512	        _restype_ = restype
   513	        _flags_ = _FUNCFLAG_CDECL | _FUNCFLAG_PYTHONAPI
   514	    return CFunctionType
   515	
   516	_cast = PYFUNCTYPE(py_object, c_void_p, py_object, py_object)(_cast_addr)
   517	def cast(obj, typ):
   518	    return _cast(obj, obj, typ)
   519	
   520	_string_at = PYFUNCTYPE(py_object, c_void_p, c_int)(_string_at_addr)
   521	def string_at(ptr, size=-1):
   522	    """string_at(ptr[, size]) -> string
   523	
   524	    Return the byte string at void *ptr."""
   525	    return _string_at(ptr, size)
   526	
   527	try:
   528	    from _ctypes import _wstring_at_addr
   529	except ImportError:
   530	    pass
   531	else:
   532	    _wstring_at = PYFUNCTYPE(py_object, c_void_p, c_int)(_wstring_at_addr)
   533	    def wstring_at(ptr, size=-1):
   534	        """wstring_at(ptr[, size]) -> string
   535	
   536	        Return the wide-character string at void *ptr."""
   537	        return _wstring_at(ptr, size)

   540	if _os.name == "nt": # COM stuff
   541	    def DllGetClassObject(rclsid, riid, ppv):
   542	        try:
   543	            ccom = __import__("comtypes.server.inprocserver", globals(), locals(), ['*'])
   544	        except ImportError:
   545	            return -2147221231 # CLASS_E_CLASSNOTAVAILABLE
   546	        else:
   547	            return ccom.DllGetClassObject(rclsid, riid, ppv)
   548	
   549	    def DllCanUnloadNow():
   550	        try:
   551	            ccom = __import__("comtypes.server.inprocserver", globals(), locals(), ['*'])
   552	        except ImportError:
   553	            return 0 # S_OK
   554	        return ccom.DllCanUnloadNow()

   556	from ctypes._endian import BigEndianStructure, LittleEndianStructure
   557	from ctypes._endian import BigEndianUnion, LittleEndianUnion

   559	# Fill in specifically-sized types
   560	c_int8 = c_byte
   561	c_uint8 = c_ubyte
   562	for kind in [c_short, c_int, c_long, c_longlong]:
   563	    if sizeof(kind) == 2: c_int16 = kind
   564	    elif sizeof(kind) == 4: c_int32 = kind
   565	    elif sizeof(kind) == 8: c_int64 = kind
   566	for kind in [c_ushort, c_uint, c_ulong, c_ulonglong]:
   567	    if sizeof(kind) == 2: c_uint16 = kind
   568	    elif sizeof(kind) == 4: c_uint32 = kind
   569	    elif sizeof(kind) == 8: c_uint64 = kind
   570	del(kind)
   571	
   572	if SIZEOF_TIME_T == 8:
   573	    c_time_t = c_int64
   574	elif SIZEOF_TIME_T == 4:
   575	    c_time_t = c_int32
   576	else:
   577	    raise SystemError(f"Unexpected sizeof(time_t): {SIZEOF_TIME_T=}")
   578	
   579	_reset_cache()
